text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun. Kawakami Princess, 
too, was set to take on the Classic Year—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (BZZZZT!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Episode 38 of PriFie really is 
simply irresistible~...!

text_block_list.name: Dark Princess
text_block_list.text: “...I have stolen so many dreams.”

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
"Then you can just support tons of dreams 
starting right now! It's not too late, 
even now!!"

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
"You're strong even without shrouding the 
world in darkness. I know we'll have an 
even hotter battle—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Guh, what a beautiful scene...?! Someday, 
I want to be just like Pre-Fie...!!
choice_data_list: Why are you watching from this room...?
Why are you watching from this room...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's obviously—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! Traine...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nuwaah!? T-Trainer? You did mention before 
that you'd 'try studying it,' but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
C-C-Could that possibly be... a disc of 
the original PreFie...!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohh! This is the absolute best!! 
Kicking off the new year with PreFie, 
aren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Didn't we agree to watch it together? 
Goodness, that was only three hours ago, 
you know!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
“At this rate, though, it looks like I can 
go all the way to the end... Hmm.”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't forget your wallet and 
smartphone. We are heading out♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's obviously—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come! We have the PriFie finale, the movie 
versions, and the latest releases right 
here!
choice_data_list: I knew it'd turn out like this~

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't be so half-hearted! Let's wrap 
up this rental agreement quick and easy!

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: “...Because I am a princess!!”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! What an iconic line! ...It's 
simply... exquisite...!
choice_data_list: You really do love PreFighter, don't you?
You really do love Purifai, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. It's practically as if I learned 
the princess's code from the PreFie 
Princess herself. It's no exaggeration to 
call it my second heart!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess is someone who is brave, 
tomboyish, and truly considerate of others 
—a being of true dignity, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
“Thinking about it again, though, I truly 
believe King-san could pull off being the 
protagonist of PreFigh. Showing her 
indomitable spirit as a first-rate PreFigh 
heroine...”
choice_data_list: By the way, weren't you going to rent it?
By the way, weren't you going to rent it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Th-That's right!! Trainer, which 
one would you like?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've seen everything, so this time, I'll 
leave it to your aesthetic sense, Trainer♪
choice_data_list:
Purifai Episode 45: Taking Speed to the 
Extreme

Soothing, up-to-date live footage of 
PreFigh

The movie version where the special moves 
are the main draw.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I. To. Tal. Ly. Get. It~~! Haaah, Trainer, 
you really get it, don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry back to our room then. Today 
is going to be a full day of non-stop 
PreFie~!

And so, the Trainer spent the entire day 
watching PriFigh with Kawakami Princess...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't that the rumored one that just 
came out and isn't available for rent 
yet...? The kind of pricey one with adult 
pricing...?
choice_data_list: I am an adult, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is sooooo true...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Nay, Lord Trainer. May I 
accompany you as well?!

After that, Kawakami Princess watched the 
concert footage with sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I see. So that is the choice you 
make~?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still, I understand. I understand 
completely, Trainer. Well then...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The original movie, the Star's movie, the 
VS movie, the 1st All-Stars movie, the 
FuraPuri movie, the 2nd All-Stars movie, 
and then...

...Kawakami Princess rattled off one title 
after another.

It looks like lunch breaks spent watching 
PreFighter movies will continue for a 
while...
